contexts.text: By to encompass, = as that the river Pison compasseth the whole land of Havilah () = they perceive to flow in; and also that the onyx stones... were to be encompassed with sockets of gold () = that the good of love should inflow into the truth of faith.
They encompassed the house () = that they were against the good of charity... To encompass = to be against it, or to attack it with a hostile animus.
Your sheaves encompassed () = those who were in the faith of some charity. To encompass = approach to adore...
In Heaven that which encompasses also lays the foundation...

Encompassed with sockets of gold shalt thou make them () = manifestation and subsistence from good... To be encompassed with sockets of gold = to be continued from good, and to derive manifestation... The case with good and truth is similar to that of the gold with which a gem is encompassed...
The Lord in person is constantly encompassed with the Sun.
Encompassed with a cloud... () = His Divine Natural.
I will compass Thine altar () = conjunction with the Lord through worship from the good of love... (for) to compass = to embrace in worship, thus to be conjoined.
A woman shall compass a man () = that a new Church is to be established, in which truth will be conjoined with its own affection... To encompass = to be conjoined.

Encompassed with a cloud () = the ultimate of the Word. To be encompassed = to be outside of him, because that which is around is also outside, being further into the circumference; here, therefore, the ultimate.
The encompassing of the city (of Jericho) = the examination of what is false and evil.

A woman encompassed with the sun () = the Church with those who are in love to the Lord and thence in love towards the neighbour... To be encompassed = to live from it; for the life's love of everyone... forms a sphere around him.
